scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:browser && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .coverage && NODE_ENV=test remix test --type server --type browser --type e2e --coverage --concurrency 2
scripts.test:webkit: npm run test:webkit:browser && npm run test:webkit:e2e
scripts.test:webkit:browser: PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1 NODE_ENV=test remix test --type browser --concurrency 3 --project webkit
scripts.test:webkit:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1 NODE_ENV=test remix test --type e2e --concurrency 2 --project webkit
scripts.test:mobile: npm run test:mobile:browser && npm run test:mobile:pages
scripts.test:mobile:browser: PLAYWRIGHT_MOBILE=1 NODE_ENV=test remix test --type browser --concurrency 3 --project mobile-chrome --project mobile-safari-sized
scripts.test:mobile:pages: PLAYWRIGHT_MOBILE=1 NODE_ENV=test remix test --type e2e --concurrency 2 --project mobile-chrome --project mobile-safari-sized app/actions/home/home-nav-responsive.test.e2e.ts app/actions/mobile-route-matrix.test.e2e.ts app/actions/admin/admin-grids-responsive.test.e2e.ts app/actions/settings/settings-responsive.test.e2e.ts app/actions/auth/auth-responsive.test.e2e.ts
scripts.test:bun: NODE_ENV=test bun node_modules/remix/dist/cli-entry.js test --type server --concurrency 6 && NODE_ENV=test bun node_modules/remix/dist/cli-entry.js test --type browser --concurrency 3 && NODE_ENV=test bun node_modules/remix/dist/cli-entry.js test --type e2e --concurrency 2
